entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Steve. How can I help you today?
Hi Steve. I'm calling because I need to make a return for a helmet I purchased.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-881-92B. I received it about, gosh, almost three months ago.
Let me just pull that up... VF-881-92B. Okay, I see it here. Looks like it was delivered 83 days ago. No problem at all.
Right. So is it too late? I wasn't sure what the policy was.
Not at all. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days, so you're well within that window. I've gone ahead and authorized the return for you.
Oh, really? That's great! So what's the next step?
I've just emailed you a prepaid return label. All you need to do is print it out, stick it on the box, and you can drop it off at the post office. It's really no problem.
Wow, that was easy. I was worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you so much for your help!
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, you can expect to see a full refund processed within 5-7 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again, Steve.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
